## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`press_release.txt`，Segment Revenue Constant Currency Reconciliation 表）：

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入 |
|---|---|
| Q4 FY26（截至 2026/6/30 三个月） | $39,306 million |
| Q4 FY25（截至 2025/6/30 三个月） | $29,878 million |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.55\%$$

微软财报披露为 **32%**（GAAP）和 **31%**（恒定汇率），差异源于四舍五入。`metrics.txt` 中同样记录为 Azure 43% 增长、Intelligent Cloud 整体 32%/31%。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会记录原话）

以下为 `transcript.txt` 中 Amy Hood（CFO）讨论 Intelligent Cloud 分部时的原话摘录（位置 25060–25270 附近）：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

此外，对 on-premises server 分部的补充说明：

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

#### ✅ 已发生的事实（本季度实际业绩驱动因素）

| # | 归因 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Azure 收入同比增长 43% | `press_release.txt` 业务亮点表 + `metrics.txt` |
| 2 | 客户需求持续超过可用产能（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"） | `transcript.txt` 位置 25060–25270 |
| 3 | CPU 和 GPU 集群的效率提升（"efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"） | 同上 |
| 4 | 流程改进使新产能更早交付（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity"） | 同上 |
| 5 | 季度内新增 Azure 产能被快速变现（"That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized"） | 同上 |
| 6 | GitHub Copilot 在 6 月定价模式变更后消费超预期（"stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value"） | 同上 |
| 7 | 本地服务器业务基本持平，恒定汇率下下降 1%，因续约合同中当期收入确认比例较高 | 同上 |

**区分依据**：这些表述描述的是 FY26 Q4 季度内已经实现的业绩驱动因素，语言为过去时态（"grew"、"was"、"benefited"），且与财报中报告的实际数字一致。

#### 🔮 前瞻性表述（管理层对未来的展望）

| # | 前瞻表述 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | "**we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply**" — 暗示供需缺口在未来仍将持续，需要持续提效来弥补 | `transcript.txt` 位置 33007（Q1 FY27 指引部分） |
| 2 | "**we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate**" — 预期上半年 Azure 增速将进一步加快 | 同上 |
| 3 | Q1 FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引为 $40.95B–$41.25B，同比增长 33%–34% | 同上 |
| 4 | Q1 FY27 Azure 恒定汇率增速预计约 45% | 同上 |
| 5 | "**year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix**" — 提示季度间增速可能波动 | 同上 |
| 6 | 本地服务器业务预计下降低至中个位数（"we expect revenue to decline in the low to mid-single digits"） | 同上 |

**区分依据**：这些表述出现在电话会的"outlook/guidance"部分，使用了将来时态和预期性措辞（"we expect"、"we remain focused"、"continue to expect"），且明确标注为对未来季度（Q1 FY27 及 H1 FY27）的预测。财报中也有专门的"Business Outlook"段落说明微软将在电话会上提供前瞻性指引。

---

### 总结

Intelligent Cloud 分部 Q4 FY26 收入 $39.3B，同比增长 ~32%（GAAP），主要由 Azure 43% 的强劲增长驱动，核心归因是需求超产能、GPU/CPU 效率提升、新产能更快交付，以及 GitHub Copilot 定价模式变更后的消费超预期。其中前 6 项为本季度已实现的事实性驱动因素，后 6 项为管理层对下季度及上半年的前瞻性展望。
